messages.subject: SemPaths and 2-level cfa
parts:
Hi all, 
I am attempting to plot a two-level cfa like so:

twolevel <- '
level: 1
  f1 =~  PAR_QI12C+ PAR_QI12F+ PAR_QI12D+ PAR_QI17E
 
level: 2
  f2 =~ T_QI3
  f3 =~ T_QI1C +T_QI2
  f4 =~ T_QG6F +T_QG6G +T_QG6H
  f5 =~ T_QG7H
'
results <- cfa(twolevel, data = PIR3levelFINAL, cluster = 'CLASSROOM_ID',verbose = TRUE, optim.method = "em", em.iter.max = 20000,
               em.fx.tol = 1e-08, em.dx.tol = 1e-04, missing="ml", std.lv=TRUE)
#results look great, now pllot
semPaths(results, "par", weighted = FALSE, nCharNodes = 7, shapeMan = "rectangle",
         sizeMan = 8, sizeMan2 = 5)

but I getting the message: error in dimnames(x) <- dn:
length of 'dimnames' [2] not equal to array extent. 

Anyone have any insight into what my problem is?
